RewardsCompetitionsNewslettersWeather ForecastEuropeExplainerWhat’s in the EU-UK reset deal? UK prime minister hopes Friday’s agreement is first step in a much closer post-Brexit relationshipFri Nov 20 2026 - 15:33 • 4 MIN READEuropean Commission president Ursula von der Leyen, Britain's prime minister Andy Burnham and European Council president Antonio Costa join hands following a EU-UK Summit. Photograph:  Nicolas Tucat/ AFP via Getty Images The EU and the UK on Friday agreed a package of measures to deepen post-Brexit ties. The three main deals will remove border checks on plant and animal exports, re-link the EU and UK carbon markets and open a Youth Experience Scheme to enable 18-to-31-year-olds to live, work and study in each other’s countries.

Here are the key points of what has been agreed:

Reporting by Peter Foster, Madeleine Speed, Andy Bounds, Ian Johnston, Chris Smyth and Henry Foy.
